definitions.sharpe: Unmodified EP004ValidLoss._sharpe_daily, close-date realized profit_abs, zero-filled fixed calendar, ddof=1, sqrt(365)
definitions.ann_return: CAGR of final wallet over the scoring calendar length / 365; fraction
definitions.sortino: Mean daily realized return / RMS negative daily return * sqrt(365), target 0
definitions.max_drawdown: Daily realized equity drawdown including initial wallet; fraction; not intraday/mark-to-market drawdown
definitions.profit_factor: Sum positive profit_abs / absolute sum negative profit_abs
definitions.turnover_per_year: 2 * sum entry stake / initial wallet / scoring years; round-trip entry-notional approximation
definitions.funding: Presence of actual funding_fees on exported trades; cross-check data manifest and engine logs
